topics.title: Combat animation and control
topics.detail: Players debate long animations, hit feedback, control feel and the balance between spectacle and interaction.
quotes: so much talks about ye shunguang and ramiella, but in the end their gameplay is bad. overly long animations, poor hit feedback, poor sense of character control, a bunch of vfx all over the screen. gameplay of a rank anby and soldier 11 from version 1.0 is literally infinitely times better. zenless was a miracle, a gacha game that really had gameplay, nkt only that but also it was better than in many non-gacha games, it was clear that the developers understood how fast combat gameplay should work, and now they forgot that they were making a game and just throwing 'chinema' animations at the screen. i need a gameplay where the character really interacts with the enemy, and not repeatedly clicking the same button combination, completely ignoring what the enemy is doing, since at this time the character on the screen performs a long "chinema" animation and is invulnerable 99% of the time.

while i do love the current character designs and outfits we are getting. please consider hiring a fashion designer to help design some of the clothing characters wear in the future. some of it has gotten a bit repetitive when it comes to style and it gets kinda boring to see. again, they aren't bad. but more unique outfits that aren't similar all the time would be nice to have. gameplay wise, you guys are cooking so hard. it really feels like you wanted to make a proper fighting game/hack and slash game and are passionate about it. i love zzz.
